insights: 7,126 streamers share 35,324 mutual follows — density 0.0014: only ~0.14% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 3.671 hops apart (diameter ≥ 10).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 16% of all tie endpoints (max degree 720 vs median 5).
Partner assortativity = -0.141: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.122: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 16 communities (modularity 0.46); the largest, C1, holds 14% of streamers.
C7 is the most 'professional' community: 7% Partners vs 5% overall.
C8 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (63% vs 55% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
146 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
217 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
